risk_note: CT-24ha (contract; D10-2585 / D10-2587, FU-TAOBAO-TOKEN-REFRESH step 1 ①). adminListUnionAccounts: each AdminUnionAccount row gains an optional auth_refreshable (boolean or null; not in required; omitted means the same as null) — true when the current credential came from a union authorization that returned re_expires_in > 0, false when it returned 0 or the platform documents it as not refreshable, null when unknown. Only the conclusion is exposed: no raw duration (re_expires_in etc.) and no token; the row stays additionalProperties false. The server does not emit it yet (the union writer task waits for the BR-ID-24 planning write-back, D10-2587).
